## Savory Cooking
Beef stroganoff uses [bold]2 raw cutlets OR 2 cooked cutlets[/bold]. Both cutlets must be in the same state. For either version, add one wooden bowl, one brown mushroom item, one onion slice, one butter slice, 5 units of cream, 1 unit of table salt, and 1 unit of black pepper. Microwave for 20 seconds. The cream, salt, and pepper can be supplied in a beaker or in the wooden bowl inside the microwave.
